```{r module-0-calibration, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Prepare public-data calibration tables for five independent annual cohorts.
# Keep observed source distributions distinct from simulation assumptions.

required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "jsonlite")
missing_packages <- setdiff(required_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) stop("Install before running Module 0: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(jsonlite)
})
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999)
# MULTI-YEAR DESIGN -------------------------------------------------------------
module_version <- "M0-MULTIYEAR-2026-09-09"
module_freeze_date <- as.Date(NA_character_)
# Output contract: these files are consumed by Module 1 and therefore form part
# of the frozen interface between the empirical calibration and simulation layers.

  "state_distribution_by_policy_year.csv", "state_remoteness_distribution_by_policy_year.csv",

  "vehicle_year_eligibility_summary.csv", "vehicle_segment_classification_audit.csv",
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 2. Module-specific helpers ----------------------------------------------------
normalise_state <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(str_to_upper(as.character(x)))
  case_when( x %in% c("NSW", "NEW SOUTH WALES", "1") ~ "NSW", x %in% c("VIC", "VICTORIA", "2") ~ "VIC",
    x %in% c("QLD", "QUEENSLAND", "3") ~ "QLD", x %in% c("SA", "SOUTH AUSTRALIA", "4") ~ "SA",
    x %in% c("WA", "WESTERN AUSTRALIA", "5") ~ "WA", x %in% c("TAS", "TASMANIA", "6") ~ "TAS",
    x %in% c("NT", "NORTHERN TERRITORY", "7") ~ "NT", x %in% c("ACT", "AUSTRALIAN CAPITAL TERRITORY", "8") ~ "ACT",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )
}
normalise_remoteness <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  case_when( str_detect(x, regex("^Major Cities", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Major Cities",
    str_detect(x, regex("^Inner Regional", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Inner Regional",
    str_detect(x, regex("^Outer Regional", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Outer Regional",
    str_detect(x, regex("^Very Remote", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Very Remote",
    str_detect(x, regex("^Remote", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Remote", TRUE ~ NA_character_ )
}
normalise_motive_power <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(str_to_lower(as.character(x)))
  case_when( is.na(x) | x == "" ~ NA_character_, str_detect(x, "hybrid") ~ "Hybrid Electric",
    str_detect(x, "battery|fuel.?cell|bev|fcev|electric") ~ "Battery/Fuel-cell Electric",
    str_detect(x, "diesel") ~ "Diesel", str_detect(x, "petrol|gasoline") ~ "Petrol",
    str_detect(x, "dual|lpg|cng|natural gas|other|not stated|unknown") ~ "Other/Dual Fuel", TRUE ~ NA_character_ )
}
normalise_postcode <- function(x) {
  digits <- str_extract(as.character(x), "[0-9]{1,4}")
  if_else(is.na(digits), NA_character_, str_pad(digits, 4, side = "left", pad = "0"))
}
check_probability_sum <- function(data, probability_column = "probability", group_columns = NULL, tolerance = 1e-8) {
  if (is.null(group_columns)) return(abs(sum(data[[probability_column]], na.rm = TRUE) - 1) <= tolerance)
  sums <- data %>% group_by(across(all_of(group_columns))) %>% summarise(probability_sum = sum(.data[[probability_column]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  all(abs(sums$probability_sum - 1) <= tolerance)
}
write_calibration_csv <- function(data, filename) {
  write_csv_safe(data, file.path(config$calibrated_dir, filename))
}
download_if_missing <- function(filename, url) {
  existing <- resolve_existing_file(filename, search_directories)
  if (!is.na(existing)) return(existing)
  if (!isTRUE(config$download_missing_public_workbooks)) stop("Missing public-source file: ", filename)
  destination <- file.path(config$raw_dir, filename)
  unlink(destination, force = TRUE)
  errors <- character()
  for (method in c("auto", "libcurl")) {
    ok <- tryCatch({
      args <- list(url = url, destfile = destination, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE)
      if (method != "auto") args$method <- method
      suppressWarnings(do.call(utils::download.file, args))
      file.exists(destination) && file.info(destination)$size > 0
    }, error = function(e) { errors <<- c(errors, paste(method, conditionMessage(e))); FALSE })
    if (ok) return(normalizePath(destination, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
    unlink(destination, force = TRUE)
  }
  curl <- Sys.which("curl")
  if (nzchar(curl)) {
    output <- tryCatch(system2(curl, c("-L", "--http1.1", "--fail", "--retry", "3", "--connect-timeout", "30", "--max-time", "180", "-o", destination, url), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(output, "error")) {
      status <- 1L
    } else {
      status <- attr(output, "status")
      if (is.null(status)) status <- 0L
    }
    if (status == 0L && file.exists(destination) && file.info(destination)$size > 0) return(normalizePath(destination, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  }
  stop("Could not download ", filename, ". Download manually from: ", url, " and place it at: ", destination,
       if (length(errors)) paste0("\nAttempts: ", paste(errors, collapse = " | ")) else "")
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 4. BITRE PASSENGER-VEHICLE GARAGING DATA
bitre_garaging_raw <- readr::read_csv( bitre_garaging_file, show_col_types = FALSE ) %>% clean_column_names()
vehicle_type_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_garaging_raw, c( "vehicle_type", "veh_type", "vehicle" ), "BITRE vehicle-type column" )
state_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_garaging_raw, c( "state_abb", "state_abbreviation", "state_territory", "state" ), "BITRE State column" )
postcode_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_garaging_raw, c( "garaging_postcode", "registered_postcode", "postcode", "poa_code", "poa", "rpc" ), "BITRE postcode column" )
vehicle_count_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_garaging_raw, c( "no_vehicles", "number_of_vehicles", "vehicle_count", "vehicles", "count" ), "BITRE vehicle-count column" )
bitre_garaging <- bitre_garaging_raw %>% transmute( vehicle_type = as.character( .data[[ vehicle_type_column ]] ),
state = normalise_state( .data[[ state_column ]] ), postcode = normalise_postcode( .data[[ postcode_column ]] ),
no_vehicles = suppressWarnings( as.numeric( .data[[ vehicle_count_column ]] ) ) ) %>%
filter( stringr::str_to_lower( vehicle_type ) == "passenger vehicles", !is.na( state ), is.finite( no_vehicles ), no_vehicles >= 0 )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
read_mesh_block_count_sheet <- function( sheet_name ) {
sheet_data <- readxl::read_excel( abs_mesh_block_counts_file, sheet = sheet_name, skip = 6 ) %>%
clean_column_names()
mb_code_col <- first_existing_column( sheet_data, c( "mb_code_2021" ), paste0( "Mesh Block code in ", sheet_name ) )
dwelling_col <- first_existing_column( sheet_data, c( "dwelling", "dwellings" ), paste0( "dwelling count in ", sheet_name ) )
person_col <- first_existing_column( sheet_data, c( "person", "persons" ), paste0( "person count in ", sheet_name ) )
sheet_data %>% transmute( mb_code = as.character( .data[[ mb_code_col ]] ),
dwelling_count = suppressWarnings( as.numeric( .data[[ dwelling_col ]] ) ),
person_count = suppressWarnings( as.numeric( .data[[ person_col ]] ) ) ) %>% filter( !is.na( mb_code ) )
}
mesh_count_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets( abs_mesh_block_counts_file )
mesh_count_sheets <- mesh_count_sheets[ stringr::str_detect( mesh_count_sheets, "^Table [1-9](\\.1)?$" ) ]
abs_mesh_counts <- purrr::map_dfr( mesh_count_sheets, read_mesh_block_count_sheet ) %>%
mutate( dwelling_count = replace_na( dwelling_count, 0 ), person_count = replace_na( person_count, 0 ),
dwelling_count = pmax( dwelling_count, 0 ), person_count = pmax( person_count, 0 ) )
# 6.5 Join the common Mesh Block geography
mesh_block_geography <- abs_poa %>% inner_join( abs_mb, by = "mb_code" ) %>%
inner_join( abs_ra, by = "sa1_code" ) %>% filter( state == ra_state ) %>%
left_join( abs_mesh_counts, by = "mb_code" ) %>% mutate( dwelling_count = replace_na( dwelling_count, 0 ),
person_count = replace_na( person_count, 0 ) )
# 6.6 Dwelling-weight each POA's overlap with Remoteness Areas
postcode_ra_components <- mesh_block_geography %>% group_by( state, postcode, remoteness_area ) %>%
summarise( dwelling_count = sum( dwelling_count, na.rm = TRUE ), person_count = sum( person_count, na.rm = TRUE ),
mesh_block_count = n_distinct( mb_code ), .groups = "drop" )
postcode_ra_weights <- postcode_ra_components %>% group_by( state, postcode ) %>%
mutate( postcode_dwelling_count = sum( dwelling_count ), postcode_person_count = sum( person_count ),
postcode_mesh_block_count = sum( mesh_block_count ),
weight_basis = case_when( postcode_dwelling_count > 0 ~ "2021 Census dwelling count",
postcode_person_count > 0 ~ "2021 Census usual resident population fallback", TRUE ~ "Mesh Block count fallback" ),
mapping_weight = case_when( postcode_dwelling_count > 0 ~ safe_divide( dwelling_count, postcode_dwelling_count ),
postcode_person_count > 0 ~ safe_divide( person_count, postcode_person_count ),
TRUE ~ safe_divide( mesh_block_count, postcode_mesh_block_count ) ) ) %>% ungroup() %>%
dplyr::select( state, postcode, remoteness_area, dwelling_count, person_count, mesh_block_count, weight_basis, mapping_weight ) %>%
arrange( state, postcode, remoteness_area )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 7. VEHICLE-WEIGHTED STATE x REMOTENESS DISTRIBUTION
bitre_postcode_vehicles <- bitre_garaging %>% filter( !is.na( postcode ) ) %>% group_by( state, postcode ) %>%
summarise( passenger_vehicles = sum( no_vehicles ), .groups = "drop" )
bitre_postcode_mapping_audit <- bitre_postcode_vehicles %>% left_join( postcode_ra_weights %>%
distinct( state, postcode ) %>% mutate( mapped_to_abs = TRUE ), by = c( "state", "postcode" ) ) %>%
mutate( mapped_to_abs = replace_na( mapped_to_abs, FALSE ) )
postcode_mapping_summary <- bitre_postcode_mapping_audit %>% group_by( state ) %>%
summarise( total_passenger_vehicles = sum( passenger_vehicles, na.rm = TRUE ),
mapped_passenger_vehicles = sum( if_else( mapped_to_abs, passenger_vehicles, 0 ), na.rm = TRUE ),
.groups = "drop" ) %>% mutate( unmapped_passenger_vehicles = total_passenger_vehicles - mapped_passenger_vehicles,
mapping_share = safe_divide( mapped_passenger_vehicles, total_passenger_vehicles ) ) %>%
transmute( state, passenger_vehicles = total_passenger_vehicles, mapped_passenger_vehicles, unmapped_passenger_vehicles, mapping_share )
overall_postcode_mapping_share <- safe_divide( sum( postcode_mapping_summary$mapped_passenger_vehicles ), sum( postcode_mapping_summary$passenger_vehicles ) )
vehicle_remoteness_allocated <- bitre_postcode_vehicles %>%
inner_join( postcode_ra_weights, by = c( "state", "postcode" ) ) %>%
mutate( allocated_passenger_vehicles = passenger_vehicles * mapping_weight )
remoteness_categories <- c( "Major Cities", "Inner Regional", "Outer Regional", "Remote", "Very Remote" )
state_order <- c( "NSW", "VIC", "QLD", "SA", "WA", "TAS", "NT", "ACT" )
state_remoteness_distribution <- vehicle_remoteness_allocated %>% group_by( state, remoteness_area ) %>%
summarise( allocated_passenger_vehicles = sum( allocated_passenger_vehicles ), .groups = "drop" ) %>%
tidyr::complete( state = state_order, remoteness_area = remoteness_categories,
fill = list( allocated_passenger_vehicles = 0 ) ) %>% group_by( state ) %>%
mutate( probability = allocated_passenger_vehicles / sum( allocated_passenger_vehicles ) ) %>% ungroup() %>%
mutate( state = factor( state, levels = state_order ),
remoteness_area = factor( remoteness_area, levels = remoteness_categories ) ) %>%
arrange( state, remoteness_area ) %>% mutate( state = as.character( state ),
remoteness_area = as.character( remoteness_area ) )
write_calibration_csv( state_remoteness_distribution, "state_remoteness_distribution.csv" )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 9. DRIVER-AGE DISTRIBUTION FROM BITRE 2025 YEARBOOK
licence_raw <- readxl::read_excel( bitre_road_yearbook_file, sheet = "Table 4.9a-i", col_names = FALSE )
table_4_9i_row <- which( stringr::str_detect( as.character( licence_raw[[ 1 ]] ), stringr::fixed( "Table 4.9i" ) ) )
if ( length( table_4_9i_row ) == 0L ) {
stop( "Could not locate Table 4.9i in the BITRE 2025 Road Yearbook." )
}
table_4_9i_row <- table_4_9i_row[ 1 ]
licence_section <- licence_raw[ table_4_9i_row:nrow( licence_raw ), 1:11 ]
persons_row <- which( stringr::str_squish( as.character( licence_section[[ 1 ]] ) ) == "Persons" )
if ( length( persons_row ) == 0L ) {
stop( "Could not locate the Persons subsection in BITRE Table 4.9i." )
}
persons_row <- persons_row[ 1 ]
latest_person_row_candidates <- which( stringr::str_squish( as.character( licence_section[[ 1 ]] ) ) == "30 June 2025" )
latest_person_row_candidates <- latest_person_row_candidates[ latest_person_row_candidates > persons_row ]
if ( length( latest_person_row_candidates ) == 0L ) {
stop( "Could not locate the 30 June 2025 Persons row in BITRE Table 4.9i." )
}
latest_person_row <- latest_person_row_candidates[ 1 ]
source_age_bands <- c( "15-19", "20-24", "25-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80+" )
source_counts <- suppressWarnings( as.numeric( unlist( licence_section[ latest_person_row, 2:10 ] ) ) )
source_total <- suppressWarnings( as.numeric( licence_section[ latest_person_row, 11 ][[ 1 ]] ) )
if ( length( source_counts ) != length( source_age_bands ) || any( !is.finite( source_counts ) ) ) {
stop( "BITRE licence-holder age counts were not extracted correctly." )
}
driver_age_source_extract <- tibble( source_age_group = source_age_bands,
source_licence_holder_count = source_counts )
driver_age_distribution <- driver_age_source_extract %>%
mutate( age_group = if_else( source_age_group == "15-19", "18-19", source_age_group ),
retained_share = if_else( source_age_group == "15-19", config$youngest_band_retained_share, 1 ),
licence_holder_count = source_licence_holder_count * retained_share ) %>%
dplyr::select( age_group, source_age_group, source_licence_holder_count, retained_share, licence_holder_count ) %>%
mutate( probability = licence_holder_count / sum( licence_holder_count ) )
write_calibration_csv( driver_age_distribution, "driver_age_distribution.csv" )
driver_age_adjustment_audit <- tibble( source_table = "BITRE 2025 Road Yearbook Table 4.9i - Persons - 30 June 2025",
source_youngest_band = "15-19", source_youngest_band_count = source_counts[ 1 ], target_simulation_band = "18-19",
frozen_module1_retained_share = config$youngest_band_retained_share,
frozen_module1_18_19_count = source_counts[ 1 ] * config$youngest_band_retained_share,
uniform_within_band_retained_share = config$uniform_18_19_share_of_15_19,
uniform_within_band_18_19_count = source_counts[ 1 ] * config$uniform_18_19_share_of_15_19,
difference_in_count = source_counts[ 1 ] * ( config$youngest_band_retained_share - config$uniform_18_19_share_of_15_19 ),
audit_note = paste( "Frozen Module 1 used 50% of the BITRE 15-19 source band.", "This is retained for baseline reproduction.", "A uniform single-age assumption would use 40%.", "Changing this requires deliberate rerunning of Modules 1-8." ) )
write_calibration_csv( driver_age_adjustment_audit, "driver_age_adjustment_audit.csv" )
if ( abs( config$youngest_band_retained_share - config$uniform_18_19_share_of_15_19 ) > 1e-12 ) {
warning( paste0( "Driver-age audit: BITRE Table 4.9i uses a 15-19 youngest band. ", "Module 0 is retaining ", 100 * config$youngest_band_retained_share, "% for frozen Module 1 compatibility. ", "A uniform 18-19 share would be 40%. See driver_age_adjustment_audit.csv." ) )
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
bitre_vehicle_year_raw <- readr::read_csv( bitre_year_file, show_col_types = FALSE ) %>% clean_column_names()
year_vehicle_type_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_vehicle_year_raw, c( "vehicle_type", "veh_type" ), "vehicle-year vehicle-type column" )
year_state_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_vehicle_year_raw, c( "state_abb", "state_abbreviation", "state_territory", "state" ), "vehicle-year State column" )
year_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_vehicle_year_raw, c( "year_of_manufacture", "manufacture_year", "year" ), "year of manufacture column" )
year_count_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_vehicle_year_raw, c( "no_vehicles", "number_of_vehicles", "vehicle_count", "vehicles", "count" ), "vehicle-year count column" )
minimum_eligible_manufacture_year <- config$vehicle_reference_year - config$max_standard_vehicle_age
bitre_vehicle_year <- bitre_vehicle_year_raw %>%
transmute( vehicle_type = as.character( .data[[ year_vehicle_type_column ]] ),
state = normalise_state( .data[[ year_state_column ]] ),
year_of_manufacture = suppressWarnings( as.integer( .data[[ year_column ]] ) ),
no_vehicles = suppressWarnings( as.numeric( .data[[ year_count_column ]] ) ) ) %>%
filter( stringr::str_to_lower( vehicle_type ) == "passenger vehicles", !is.na( state ), !is.na( year_of_manufacture ), is.finite( no_vehicles ), no_vehicles > 0 ) %>%
group_by( state, year_of_manufacture ) %>% summarise( no_vehicles = sum( no_vehicles ), .groups = "drop" )
vehicle_year_eligibility_summary <- bitre_vehicle_year %>%
mutate( eligible_standard_market = year_of_manufacture >= minimum_eligible_manufacture_year & year_of_manufacture <= config$vehicle_reference_year ) %>%
group_by( state ) %>% summarise( registered_passenger_vehicles = sum( no_vehicles ),
eligible_passenger_vehicles = sum( no_vehicles[ eligible_standard_market ] ),
excluded_passenger_vehicles = registered_passenger_vehicles - eligible_passenger_vehicles,
eligible_share = safe_divide( eligible_passenger_vehicles, registered_passenger_vehicles ),
excluded_share = 1 - eligible_share, .groups = "drop" )
vehicle_year_distribution_by_state <- bitre_vehicle_year %>%
filter( year_of_manufacture >= minimum_eligible_manufacture_year, year_of_manufacture <= config$vehicle_reference_year ) %>%
group_by( state ) %>% mutate( probability = no_vehicles / sum( no_vehicles ) ) %>% ungroup() %>%
arrange( state, year_of_manufacture )
write_calibration_csv( vehicle_year_eligibility_summary, "vehicle_year_eligibility_summary.csv" )
write_calibration_csv( vehicle_year_distribution_by_state, "vehicle_year_distribution_by_state.csv" )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
mm_count_column <- first_existing_column( bitre_make_model_raw, c( "no_vehicles", "number_of_vehicles", "vehicle_count", "vehicles", "count" ), "make/model vehicle-count column" )

year_of_manufacture = as.character( .data[[ mm_year_column ]] ),
year_numeric = suppressWarnings( as.integer( .data[[ mm_year_column ]] ) ),
make = stringr::str_squish( stringr::str_to_upper( as.character( .data[[ mm_make_column ]] ) ) ),
model = stringr::str_squish( stringr::str_to_upper( as.character( .data[[ mm_model_column ]] ) ) ),
no_vehicles = suppressWarnings( as.numeric( .data[[ mm_count_column ]] ) ) ) %>%
filter( stringr::str_to_lower( vehicle_type ) == "passenger vehicles", !is.na( year_numeric ), year_numeric >= minimum_eligible_manufacture_year, year_numeric <= config$vehicle_reference_year, is.finite( no_vehicles ), no_vehicles > 0 ) %>%
dplyr::select( -vehicle_type )

unclassified_vehicle_weight <- safe_divide( sum( classified_make_model$no_vehicles[ is.na( classified_make_model$vehicle_segment ) ] ), sum( classified_make_model$no_vehicles ) )

summarise( no_vehicles = sum( no_vehicles ), .groups = "drop" ) %>% group_by( year_of_manufacture ) %>%
mutate( probability = no_vehicles / sum( no_vehicles ) ) %>% ungroup() %>%
arrange( year_of_manufacture, vehicle_segment )
vehicle_segment_overall <- classified_make_model %>% group_by( vehicle_segment ) %>%
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 12.1 CAREXPERT VEHICLE-SPECIFICATION CALIBRATION
# The CarExpert lookup contains representative configurations for BITRE
# make/model/year combinations. Coverage is measured using BITRE passenger-
# vehicle counts, not the proportion of lookup rows. Where more than one
# CarExpert configuration is available for a make/model/year, an exact
# motive-power match is preferred. Otherwise a representative configuration for
# the same make/model/year is retained and explicitly flagged.
carexpert_vehicle_specs_raw <- readr::read_csv( carexpert_vehicle_spec_lookup_file, show_col_types = FALSE ) %>%
  clean_column_names()
required_vehicle_spec_columns <- c( "year_of_manufacture", "make", "model", "variant", "motive_power",
  "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "power_rpm",
  "torque_nm", "torque_rpm", "transmission_raw", "transmission_group",
  "unladen_weight_kg", "source_url", "source_access_date" )
missing_vehicle_spec_columns <- setdiff( required_vehicle_spec_columns, names(carexpert_vehicle_specs_raw) )
if (length(missing_vehicle_spec_columns) > 0L) {
  stop( "CarExpert vehicle specification lookup is missing: ", paste(missing_vehicle_spec_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
carexpert_vehicle_specs <- carexpert_vehicle_specs_raw %>% transmute(
    year_of_manufacture = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year_of_manufacture)),
    make = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_to_upper(as.character(make))),
    model = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_to_upper(as.character(model))), variant = as.character(variant),
    carexpert_motive_power_raw = as.character(motive_power),
    carexpert_motive_power = normalise_motive_power(motive_power),
    engine_capacity_l = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(engine_capacity_l)),
    cylinder_count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cylinder_count)),
    power_kw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(power_kw)), power_rpm = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(power_rpm)),
    torque_nm = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(torque_nm)), torque_rpm = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(torque_rpm)),
    transmission_raw = as.character(transmission_raw), transmission_group = as.character(transmission_group),
    unladen_weight_kg = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unladen_weight_kg)), source_url = as.character(source_url),
    source_access_date = as.character(source_access_date) ) %>% filter( !is.na(year_of_manufacture),
    year_of_manufacture >= minimum_eligible_manufacture_year, year_of_manufacture <= config$vehicle_reference_year,
    !is.na(make), make != "", !is.na(model), model != "" ) %>% mutate( spec_completeness = rowSums(cbind(
      is.finite(power_kw), is.finite(torque_nm), is.finite(unladen_weight_kg),
      !is.na(transmission_group) & transmission_group != "" )) )
# One deterministic representative per make/model/year/motive-power combination.
carexpert_spec_by_motive <- carexpert_vehicle_specs %>% arrange(
    year_of_manufacture, make, model, carexpert_motive_power, desc(spec_completeness), variant ) %>%
  group_by(year_of_manufacture, make, model, carexpert_motive_power) %>% slice(1L) %>% ungroup()
# One deterministic default representative per make/model/year for cases where
# BITRE motive power does not match the representative CarExpert configuration.
carexpert_spec_default <- carexpert_vehicle_specs %>% arrange( year_of_manufacture, make, model,
    desc(spec_completeness), variant ) %>% group_by(year_of_manufacture, make, model) %>% slice(1L) %>% ungroup()
spec_columns <- c( "variant", "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "power_rpm",
  "torque_nm", "torque_rpm", "transmission_raw", "transmission_group",
  "unladen_weight_kg", "source_url", "source_access_date" )
carexpert_exact <- carexpert_spec_by_motive %>% select( year_of_manufacture, make, model,
    motive_power = carexpert_motive_power, all_of(spec_columns) ) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("exact_", .x), all_of(spec_columns))
carexpert_default <- carexpert_spec_default %>% select(year_of_manufacture, make, model, all_of(spec_columns)) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("default_", .x), all_of(spec_columns))
# Aggregate the detailed BITRE extract to the exact joint structure that Module 1
# will sample: manufacture year x make x model x segment x motive power.
vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year <- classified_motive_power %>% group_by( year_of_manufacture = year_numeric,
    make, model, vehicle_segment, motive_power ) %>%
  summarise(no_vehicles = sum(no_vehicles), .groups = "drop") %>% left_join( carexpert_exact,
    by = c("year_of_manufacture", "make", "model", "motive_power") ) %>% left_join( carexpert_default,
    by = c("year_of_manufacture", "make", "model") ) %>% mutate( vehicle_spec_match_status = case_when(
      !is.na(exact_source_url) ~ "CarExpert motive-power match",
      !is.na(default_source_url) ~ "CarExpert representative make-model-year",
      TRUE ~ "Empirical donor fallback required" ), variant = coalesce(exact_variant, default_variant),
    engine_capacity_l = coalesce(exact_engine_capacity_l, default_engine_capacity_l),
    cylinder_count = coalesce(exact_cylinder_count, default_cylinder_count),
    power_kw = coalesce(exact_power_kw, default_power_kw),
    power_rpm = coalesce(exact_power_rpm, default_power_rpm),
    torque_nm = coalesce(exact_torque_nm, default_torque_nm),
    torque_rpm = coalesce(exact_torque_rpm, default_torque_rpm),
    transmission_raw = coalesce(exact_transmission_raw, default_transmission_raw),
    transmission_group = coalesce(exact_transmission_group, default_transmission_group),
    unladen_weight_kg = coalesce(exact_unladen_weight_kg, default_unladen_weight_kg),
    source_url = coalesce(exact_source_url, default_source_url),
    source_access_date = coalesce(exact_source_access_date, default_source_access_date),
    has_carexpert_spec = !is.na(source_url) ) %>% group_by(year_of_manufacture) %>%
  mutate(probability = no_vehicles / sum(no_vehicles)) %>% ungroup() %>% select(
    year_of_manufacture, make, model, vehicle_segment, motive_power,
    no_vehicles, probability, vehicle_spec_match_status, has_carexpert_spec,
    variant, engine_capacity_l, cylinder_count, power_kw, power_rpm,
    torque_nm, torque_rpm, transmission_raw, transmission_group, unladen_weight_kg, source_url, source_access_date
  ) %>% arrange(year_of_manufacture, desc(no_vehicles), make, model, motive_power)
vehicle_spec_weighted_coverage <- safe_divide( sum(vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year$no_vehicles[
    vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year$has_carexpert_spec ]), sum(vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year$no_vehicles) )
vehicle_spec_motive_match_share <- safe_divide( sum(vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year$no_vehicles[
    vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year$vehicle_spec_match_status == "CarExpert motive-power match" ]),
  sum(vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year$no_vehicles) )
# Donor pool used only for the residual unmatched fleet and for isolated missing
# numerical fields. Module 1 uses a transparent hierarchical donor rule rather
# than inventing specification values.
vehicle_spec_donor_pool <- vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year %>% filter(has_carexpert_spec) %>%
  mutate(donor_weight = no_vehicles) %>% select( year_of_manufacture, make, model, vehicle_segment, motive_power,
    donor_weight, variant, engine_capacity_l, cylinder_count, power_kw, power_rpm, torque_nm, torque_rpm,
    transmission_raw, transmission_group, unladen_weight_kg, source_url, source_access_date )
vehicle_specification_audit <- tibble( metric = c( "BITRE-weighted CarExpert specification coverage",
    "BITRE-weighted exact motive-power specification match share",
    "BITRE-weighted residual requiring empirical donor fallback",
    "Unique CarExpert make-model-year keys in eligible lookup" ), value = c( vehicle_spec_weighted_coverage,
    vehicle_spec_motive_match_share, 1 - vehicle_spec_weighted_coverage, nrow(carexpert_spec_default) ) )
write_calibration_csv( vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year, "vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year.csv" )
write_calibration_csv( vehicle_spec_donor_pool, "vehicle_spec_donor_pool.csv" )
write_calibration_csv( vehicle_specification_audit, "vehicle_specification_audit.csv" )
# 12.2 Motive-power annual-kilometre calibration
motive_power_km_calibration <- tribble( ~motive_power, ~source_mean_annual_km, ~km_relativity, ~evidence_classification,
"Petrol", 10500, 10500 / 11100, "ABS empirical", "Diesel", 13900, 13900 / 11100, "ABS empirical",
"Hybrid Electric", NA_real_, 1.00, "Neutral assumption pending separate empirical estimate",
"Battery/Fuel-cell Electric", 11100, 11100 / 11100, "ABS battery-electric empirical; applied to combined BITRE BEV/FCEV category",
"Other/Dual Fuel", NA_real_, 1.00, "Neutral assumption pending separate empirical estimate" ) %>%
mutate( source = "ABS Electric passenger vehicle use, experimental estimates, 12 months ended 30 June 2020",
source_url = "https://www.abs.gov.au/articles/electric-passenger-vehicle-use-experimental-estimates" )
write_calibration_csv( motive_power_km_calibration, "motive_power_km_calibration.csv" )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
)

  "additional_quote_variable_assumption_register.csv" )
# 14A. MULTI-YEAR NEW-BUSINESS CALIBRATION (2021-2025)
# The detailed 2025 calibration above remains the common classification and
# CarExpert specification layer. This section adds annual fleet weights and
# calendar-year monetary cost levels for five independent new-business cohorts.
# Raw annual fleet inputs
# The 2021-2025 Road Vehicles Australia datasets are available from data.gov.au.
# Rather than requiring ten manually prepared files, Module 0 retrieves the two
# required CSV resources for each annual snapshot when they are not already
# present in inputs/raw/multiyear:
#   vehicle_state_year_YYYY.csv
#     vehicle_type, state/state_abb, year_of_manufacture, no_vehicles
#   vehicle_motive_yom_make_model_YYYY.csv
#     vehicle_type, year_of_manufacture, motive_power, make, model, no_vehicles
# This uses the official data.gov.au CKAN metadata API to locate the relevant
# BITRE resource URLs by resource title. The local copies are retained so later
# reruns remain reproducible even if the source portal changes.
# Important 2021 note:
# BITRE/data.gov.au now provides a retrospective Road Vehicles Australia
# snapshot for 31 January 2021 derived from state/territory registry data.
# Therefore the multi-year calibration can use one consistent BITRE/NEVDIS-style
# source family for 2021-2025 rather than manually transforming ABS TableBuilder
# output. The ABS 2021 Motor Vehicle Census remains useful as an external
# reasonableness check but is no longer a required raw input.
bitre_package_ids <- tibble::tribble( ~policy_year, ~package_id, 2021L, "292a071b-71f0-48c4-8617-c2ee0ca1ff2e",
  2022L, "c34b68b7-b482-48c4-86ad-a426e22dd761", 2023L, "787053f6-97e1-4170-8e41-32a57277489a",
  2024L, "767b84b8-6756-460a-96c9-9c073153485a", 2025L, "f6e0a290-7d47-4b88-ac3b-34824b0ab334" )
normalise_resource_name <- function(x) {
  x |> stringr::str_to_lower() |> stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", " ") |> stringr::str_squish()
}
find_bitre_resource_url <- function(policy_year, resource_role) {
  package_id <- bitre_package_ids$package_id[bitre_package_ids$policy_year == policy_year]
  if (length(package_id) != 1L) stop("No BITRE package id registered for policy year ", policy_year, ".")
  api_url <- paste0( "https://data.gov.au/data/api/3/action/package_show?id=", package_id )
  meta <- tryCatch( jsonlite::fromJSON(api_url, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE), error = function(e) stop(
      "Could not read data.gov.au metadata for ", policy_year, ". ",
      "Check your internet connection or place the annual CSVs manually in ",
      config$multiyear_raw_dir, ". Original error: ", conditionMessage(e) ) )
  if (!isTRUE(meta$success)) stop("data.gov.au metadata request failed for ", policy_year, ".")
  resources <- meta$result$resources
  if (!is.data.frame(resources) || nrow(resources) == 0L) {
    stop("No resources returned for BITRE Road Vehicles Australia ", policy_year, ".")
  }
  resource_names <- normalise_resource_name(resources$name)
  has_all_terms <- function(x, terms) {
    Reduce( `&`, lapply(terms, function(term) stringr::str_detect(x, stringr::fixed(term))) )
  }
  if (resource_role == "state_x_manufacture_year") {
    # Match by required concepts rather than title word order.
    # Explicitly exclude postcode, motive-power and make/model resources.
    keep <- has_all_terms( resource_names, c("vehicle type", "state", "year of manufacture") ) &
      !stringr::str_detect(resource_names, "postcode|motive power|make|model")
  } else if (resource_role == "motive_power_x_yom_x_make_x_model") {
    # BITRE title ordering differs between annual releases. For example,
    # 2025 uses "... year of manufacture, motive power, make and model ...".
    # Require all concepts, irrespective of their order.
    keep <- has_all_terms( resource_names,
      c("vehicle type", "year of manufacture", "motive power", "make", "model") ) &
      !stringr::str_detect(resource_names, "state|postcode")
  } else {
    stop("Unknown BITRE resource role: ", resource_role)
  }
  candidates <- resources[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(candidates) != 1L) {
    stop( "Could not uniquely identify the ", resource_role,
      " BITRE CSV for ", policy_year, ". Candidates found: ",
      if (nrow(candidates) == 0L) "none" else paste(candidates$name, collapse = " | ") )
  }
  candidates$url[[1]]
}
download_bitre_annual_resource <- function(policy_year, source_role, destination) {
  if (file.exists(destination) && file.info(destination)$size > 100L) {
    return(invisible(destination))
  }
  url <- find_bitre_resource_url(policy_year, source_role)
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  message("Downloading BITRE ", policy_year, " ", source_role, "...")
  status <- tryCatch( utils::download.file(url, destination, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE), error = function(e) e )
  if (inherits(status, "error") || !file.exists(destination) || file.info(destination)$size <= 100L) {
    if (file.exists(destination)) unlink(destination)
    stop( "Automatic download failed for BITRE ", policy_year, " ", source_role, ". ",
      "You can download the corresponding Road Vehicles Australia CSV manually ",
      "from data.gov.au and save it as ", basename(destination), "." )
  }
  invisible(destination)
}
multiyear_source_requirements <- tidyr::crossing( policy_year = config$cohort_years,
  source_role = c("state_x_manufacture_year", "motive_power_x_yom_x_make_x_model") ) |> mutate(
    expected_filename = if_else( source_role == "state_x_manufacture_year",
      paste0("vehicle_state_year_", policy_year, ".csv"),
      paste0("vehicle_motive_yom_make_model_", policy_year, ".csv") ),
    provider = "BITRE Road Vehicles Australia / data.gov.au", status = "required; auto-download if absent" )
purrr::pwalk( multiyear_source_requirements |> transmute( policy_year, source_role,
      destination = file.path(config$multiyear_raw_dir, expected_filename) ), download_bitre_annual_resource )
write_calibration_csv(multiyear_source_requirements, "multiyear_source_requirements.csv")
# Cost-level input

    motor_vehicle_price_level = as.numeric(motor_vehicle_price_level) ) |> arrange(policy_year)
if (!setequal(annual_cost_level_indices$policy_year, config$cohort_years) ||
    any(!is.finite(annual_cost_level_indices$claims_cost_level)) ||
    any(!is.finite(annual_cost_level_indices$motor_vehicle_price_level)) ||
    any(annual_cost_level_indices$claims_cost_level <= 0) ||
    any(annual_cost_level_indices$motor_vehicle_price_level <= 0) ||
    abs(annual_cost_level_indices$claims_cost_level[annual_cost_level_indices$policy_year == 2025] - 1) > 1e-10 ||
    abs(annual_cost_level_indices$motor_vehicle_price_level[annual_cost_level_indices$policy_year == 2025] - 1) > 1e-10) {
  stop("annual_cost_indices_2021_2025.csv is invalid. It must cover 2021-2025 with positive finite indices and 2025 = 1.")
}
write_calibration_csv(annual_cost_level_indices, "annual_cost_level_indices.csv")
read_annual_state_year <- function(policy_year) {
  f <- file.path(config$multiyear_raw_dir, paste0("vehicle_state_year_", policy_year, ".csv"))
  x <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(x) <- names(x) |> stringr::str_to_lower() |> stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") |> stringr::str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  if (!"state" %in% names(x) && "state_abb" %in% names(x)) {
    x <- x |> dplyr::rename(state = state_abb)
  }
  needed <- c("vehicle_type", "state", "year_of_manufacture", "no_vehicles")
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(x))
  if (length(miss) > 0L) stop(basename(f), " missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  x |> transmute( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year), vehicle_type = as.character(vehicle_type),
      state = normalise_state(state), year_of_manufacture = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year_of_manufacture)),
      no_vehicles = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(no_vehicles)) ) |> filter(
      stringr::str_to_lower(vehicle_type) == "passenger vehicles",
      state %in% sort(unique(state_distribution$state)), is.finite(no_vehicles), no_vehicles > 0,
      !is.na(year_of_manufacture), year_of_manufacture <= policy_year,
      year_of_manufacture >= policy_year - config$max_standard_vehicle_age )
}
read_annual_make_model <- function(policy_year) {
  f <- file.path(config$multiyear_raw_dir, paste0("vehicle_motive_yom_make_model_", policy_year, ".csv"))
  x <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(x) <- names(x) |> stringr::str_to_lower() |> stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") |> stringr::str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  needed <- c("vehicle_type", "year_of_manufacture", "motive_power", "make", "model", "no_vehicles")
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(x))
  if (length(miss) > 0L) stop(basename(f), " missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  x |> transmute( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year), vehicle_type = as.character(vehicle_type),
      year_of_manufacture = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year_of_manufacture)),
      motive_power = normalise_motive_power(motive_power),
      make = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_to_upper(as.character(make))),
      model = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_to_upper(as.character(model))),
      no_vehicles = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(no_vehicles)) ) |> filter(
      stringr::str_to_lower(vehicle_type) == "passenger vehicles",
      !is.na(year_of_manufacture), year_of_manufacture <= policy_year,
      year_of_manufacture >= policy_year - config$max_standard_vehicle_age,
      !is.na(motive_power), make != "", model != "", is.finite(no_vehicles), no_vehicles > 0 )
}
annual_state_year_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(config$cohort_years, read_annual_state_year)
annual_make_model_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(config$cohort_years, read_annual_make_model)
state_distribution_by_policy_year <- annual_state_year_raw |> group_by(policy_year, state) |>
  summarise(no_vehicles = sum(no_vehicles), .groups = "drop") |> group_by(policy_year) |>
  mutate(probability = no_vehicles / sum(no_vehicles)) |> ungroup() |> arrange(policy_year, state)
# Broad remoteness composition is held at the empirically derived 2025
# P(Remoteness | State), while annual State weights vary empirically.
state_remoteness_distribution_by_policy_year <- tidyr::crossing( policy_year = config$cohort_years,
  state_remoteness_distribution ) |> arrange(policy_year, state, remoteness_area)
vehicle_year_distribution_by_policy_year_state <- annual_state_year_raw |>
  group_by(policy_year, state, year_of_manufacture) |>
  summarise(no_vehicles = sum(no_vehicles), .groups = "drop") |> group_by(policy_year, state) |>
  mutate(probability = no_vehicles / sum(no_vehicles)) |> ungroup() |>
  arrange(policy_year, state, year_of_manufacture)
# Apply the same curated FCAI/GVG segment classification to each annual fleet.
annual_make_model_classified <- annual_make_model_raw |> left_join( vehicle_segment_lookup |> transmute(
        year_of_manufacture = as.integer(year_of_manufacture),
        make = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_to_upper(make)),
        model = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_to_upper(model)), vehicle_segment ),
    by = c("year_of_manufacture", "make", "model") ) |>
  mutate(vehicle_segment = replace_na(vehicle_segment, "People Mover/Other Passenger"))
vehicle_make_model_distribution_by_policy_year <- annual_make_model_classified |>
  group_by(policy_year, year_of_manufacture, make, model, motive_power, vehicle_segment) |>
  summarise(no_vehicles = sum(no_vehicles), .groups = "drop") |> group_by(policy_year, year_of_manufacture) |>
  mutate(probability = no_vehicles / sum(no_vehicles)) |> ungroup() |>
  arrange(policy_year, year_of_manufacture, desc(probability))
vehicle_segment_motive_power_by_policy_year_yom <- annual_make_model_classified |>
  group_by(policy_year, year_of_manufacture, vehicle_segment, motive_power) |>
  summarise(no_vehicles = sum(no_vehicles), .groups = "drop") |> group_by(policy_year, year_of_manufacture) |>
  mutate(probability = no_vehicles / sum(no_vehicles)) |> ungroup() |>
  arrange(policy_year, year_of_manufacture, vehicle_segment, motive_power)
write_calibration_csv(state_distribution_by_policy_year, "state_distribution_by_policy_year.csv")
write_calibration_csv(state_remoteness_distribution_by_policy_year, "state_remoteness_distribution_by_policy_year.csv")
write_calibration_csv(vehicle_year_distribution_by_policy_year_state, "vehicle_year_distribution_by_policy_year_state.csv")
write_calibration_csv(vehicle_make_model_distribution_by_policy_year, "vehicle_make_model_distribution_by_policy_year.csv")
write_calibration_csv(vehicle_segment_motive_power_by_policy_year_yom, "vehicle_segment_motive_power_by_policy_year_yom.csv")
multiyear_calibration_validation_checks <- bind_rows( state_distribution_by_policy_year |> group_by(policy_year) |>
    summarise(check_name = "State probabilities sum to one", observed_value = sum(probability), pass = abs(observed_value - 1) < 1e-8, .groups = "drop"),
  vehicle_year_distribution_by_policy_year_state |> group_by(policy_year, state) |>
    summarise(check_name = "Vehicle-year probabilities sum to one within year x state", observed_value = sum(probability), pass = abs(observed_value - 1) < 1e-8, .groups = "drop"),
  vehicle_make_model_distribution_by_policy_year |> group_by(policy_year, year_of_manufacture) |>
    summarise(check_name = "Make-model probabilities sum to one within cohort x manufacture year", observed_value = sum(probability), pass = abs(observed_value - 1) < 1e-8, .groups = "drop")
) |> mutate(required_for_progress = TRUE)
cost_index_checks <- tibble( policy_year = config$cohort_years,
  check_name = "Annual monetary cost indices positive; 2025 normalised to one",
  observed_value = annual_cost_level_indices$claims_cost_level,
  pass = annual_cost_level_indices$claims_cost_level > 0 & annual_cost_level_indices$motor_vehicle_price_level > 0,
  required_for_progress = TRUE )
multiyear_calibration_validation_checks <- bind_rows(multiyear_calibration_validation_checks, cost_index_checks)
write_calibration_csv(multiyear_calibration_validation_checks, "multiyear_calibration_validation_checks.csv")
if (!all(multiyear_calibration_validation_checks$pass)) {
  print(multiyear_calibration_validation_checks, n = Inf)
  stop("At least one required multi-year Module 0 calibration check failed.")
}
```
